summary: Washington County tower on Mark Twain National Forest land; the Central US record marks it removed, with no date and no build details found.

notes_for_editor: Only one source was found: a short Central US Lookouts record with a status label, agency, county and township-range-section. It is not in the NHLR or FFLOS Missouri lists. The web search and page reads found no build date, design, staffing or site description, so the story is short. The Township 36 North, Range 1 East, Section 9 location comes from the record's 36N-1E-9 code. A Mark Twain National Forest record or a newspaper would be needed to fill in the history.
